description.narrative: Philippines - Community Development Grants Project - Community Services Activity: MCC Funding will be granted to Department of Social Welfare and Development ("DSWD"), to be used by DSWD to plan and implement community-chosen sub-projects in accordance with the KALAHI-CIDSS Project manuals approved by MCC. Specifically, the KALAHI-CIDSS Project provides grants for livelihood activities and the construction, repair and improvement/upgrading of small-scale rural infrastructure sub-projects identified by the community.
